description: This PHP source file defines a view class for editing quote records in SuiteCRM, extending the conventional ViewEdit class. It includes a constructor, a display method, and a method to populate quote template options from the database.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to handle quote editing view with additional quote template population functionality.

methods.description: Initializes the class by calling the parent constructor.
